title: Coefficientwise extension along an injective ring homomorphism preserves degree, leading coefficient and constant coefficient
statement:
Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be an injective ring homomorphism of commutative rings, $T$ an indeterminate, and $\varphi_*:R[T]\to S[T]$ the coefficientwise extension [lem-weil-coefficientwise-extension-injective]. For every $P\in R[T]$, with degree, leading coefficient and coefficients $[T^m]P$ as in [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient] and [def-weil-polynomial-ring]:

$$
\deg\varphi_*(P)=\deg P,\qquad
[T^{\deg P}]\varphi_*(P)=\varphi\bigl([T^{\deg P}]P\bigr),\qquad
[T^m]\varphi_*(P)=\varphi\bigl([T^m]P\bigr)\ \text{for every }m\geq0,
$$

in particular $\varphi_*(P)(0)=\varphi(P(0))$, and $\varphi_*(P)(0)=1$ if and only if $P(0)=1$.

In particular, for a prime $\ell$ such that $\mathbf Z\to\Ql$ is injective, every $P\in\mathbf Z[T]$ has $\deg P^{(\ell)}=\deg P$ and $P^{(\ell)}(0)=P(0)\cdot1_{\Ql}$ [def-weil-coefficientwise-extension].
